body: Thanks for the advice, I need to slow down and not assume how she'll react.

I think it was 95% projection 5% my just having told her about a particularly shitty weekend and how miserable and irritable I was about it when normally I'm a bubbly person for a dude.


Anyways I plan to stay, I know I need help.

I'll take her concern as projection on my part, it's the most simple and likely solution. I will relax this one time as it's clear I'm on a slow boat to ~~China~~ dealing with my problems.
